items.title: Google illegally cut down 250K trees in Finland for data center

brief.whatHappened: "Google illegally cut down 250K trees in Finland for data center" reached the Hacker News front page with 253 points and 201 comments.
brief.whyItMatters: The energy and water cost of AI is part of the engineering trade-off. Numbers from real deployments let you argue for a smaller model or a cached answer.

keyConcepts.explanation: The electricity one model request consumes. It depends on model size, hardware and batching, and published figures often leave out training.
Grams of CO2 emitted per kilowatt hour. It changes by region and by hour, so where and when a job runs matters.

items.title: How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills
items.excerpt: As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team spotlights @r31n, diving into their research approach, favorite bug classes, and advice for aspiring hackers.

brief.whatHappened: GitHub Security Blog published "How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills". As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team spotlights @r31n, diving into their research approach, favorite bug classes, and advice for aspiring hackers.
brief.whyItMatters: A flaw found in someone else's stack is often present in yours. Reading the attack tells you which assumption to check in your own code.

keyConcepts.explanation: A public identifier for one specific vulnerability, so advisories, scanners and patches can refer to the same flaw.
A list of what you protect, who might attack it and where trust changes hands. It tells you which defences are worth building.
